privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro_p1: Kim & Co., Ltd. (the 'Company') complies with the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea and other applicable laws, and establishes and discloses this privacy policy to protect users' personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect and How
body: The Company collects the following information through the contact form on this website.
list: Required: name, email address, and the content of your inquiry
If you voluntarily include additional personal information (such as a phone number) in your message, it will be collected as part of your inquiry.
body2: The Company does not operate user accounts and does not use cookies or other automatic data collection tools. Your language preference is stored only in your browser and is not transmitted to the Company.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of Collection and Use
body: Collected information is used solely to receive and respond to inquiries, including those regarding partnerships, investment, and sales.

sections.title: 3. Retention Period
body: Inquiry data is retained for one year after the inquiry is resolved and then deleted without delay, unless a longer retention period is required by applicable law.

sections.title: 4. Provision to Third Parties
body: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties, except in the following cases:
list: When the user has given prior consent
When requested by investigative or government agencies through lawful procedures

sections.title: 5. Outsourcing and Overseas Transfer
body: The Company outsources the following processing tasks, in the course of which personal information may be transferred overseas:
list: Inquiry email delivery: EmailJS Inc. (USA) — information entered in the contact form is transmitted upon submission

sections.title: 6. Destruction of Personal Information
body: Personal information is destroyed without delay once the purpose of collection has been fulfilled. Electronic files are deleted using methods that prevent recovery, and paper documents are shredded or incinerated.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
body: You may request access to, correction or deletion of, or suspension of processing of your personal information at any time by contacting the privacy officer below in writing, by phone, or by email.

sections.title: 8. Security Measures
body: The Company limits access to personal information to the minimum necessary personnel and applies safeguards such as encryption in transit (HTTPS).

officer.title: 9. Privacy Officer
officer.p1: The Company has designated the following privacy officer and staff to oversee personal information processing and handle related inquiries and complaints.

remedies.title: 10. Remedies for Infringement
remedies.p1: If you need to report or consult on a personal information infringement, you may contact the following Korean authorities.
orgs_html: Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (www.kopico.go.kr / +82-1833-6972)
KISA Privacy Infringement Report Center (privacy.kisa.or.kr / 118 in Korea)
Supreme Prosecutors' Office (www.spo.go.kr / 1301)
National Police Agency Cyber Bureau (ecrm.police.go.kr / 182)

change.title: 11. Changes to This Policy
change.p1: Any changes to this privacy policy will be announced on this website at least seven days before they take effect.

noemail.title: No Email Collection
noemail.p1: We refuse the unauthorized collection of email addresses posted on this website by means of email-harvesting programs or any other technical devices. Violations are subject to criminal penalties under the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection of Korea.
